spec_match.rationale: Implements the spec's first step exactly (detached iframe → document not fully active → InvalidStateError) and both chromestatus-listed TypeError cases (missing argument, illegal receiver), distinguishing synchronous throw from rejection.

interactive.rationale: Detached-document sequence button with attached control arm and cross-realm call, plus three WebIDL error buttons, each printing verbatim outcomes.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Card promises detached-document InvalidStateError vs silent undefined and TypeError-as-rejection; all shown.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers attached vs detached, same- vs cross-realm receiver ([[Class]] tag used because instanceof fails cross-realm), a never-settling foreign promise (timeout, reported not guessed), and boolean coercion of a truthy string with a cleanup call.

conformance.rationale: Backs detached-document-rejects-invalidstateerror and missing-argument-rejects-not-throws (both fail on Chrome 153 as expected).

runtime_evidence.rationale: Verified with headless Chrome for Testing 153 via Playwright (chrome-devtools-mcp is NOT available in this environment, so this is not DevTools-MCP verification). Chrome 153 has the OLD shape; the new-shape branches were exercised only with a test-only init-script shim in the harness (never shipped). Default: all three detached calls returned undefined (legacy verdict); no-arg and illegal receiver threw synchronous TypeError. Shim: B and C rejected InvalidStateError, the TypeErrors arrived as rejections. Notable: the detached iframe's promise reactions DID run in Chromium 153. Zero console errors.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5188639100370944 plus the spec section and MDN/WebIDL/HTML references relevant to this concept.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only (bg-paper/stone/ivory, text-charcoal/black/muted, accent-emerald-dark/rose/blue/amber-as-border-only); every button override sets both background and color; no raw hex.

accessibility.rationale: Throwaway iframe is aria-hidden and titled; verdicts aria-live polite; buttons labelled by visible call text; outcomes in an output element.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Driven at 360x740 (DPR 3, touch, isMobile) and 1280x800: 0px horizontal overflow on both, button rows wrap, 44px targets, screenshots read for both classes.

telemetry_health.rationale: demo-telemetry.js loaded; showcaseTelemetry.assert fires for the primary contract and for the legacy/fallback branch with the raw shape/state as details.

openQuestions.title: Confirm real Chrome 159 rejection from a detached iframe
openQuestions.detail: The InvalidStateError branch was only exercised with a shim. On Chrome 159 confirm the returned promise is created in the detached realm (instanceof false from the parent) and that its rejection reaction runs.

openQuestions.title: bfcache as a second not-fully-active case
openQuestions.detail: A document in the back/forward cache is also not fully active; investigate whether a pagehide-captured reference can be called meaningfully to show the same rejection.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region for asynchronous result announcements
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use aria-live=polite for standard result/status updates; reserve assertive for critical interruptions; avoid announcing interstitial 'loading' noise.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Verdicts/readouts are aria-live polite; per-call result cards and logs are NOT live (they are navigable on demand) to avoid spam.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow on mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: flex-wrap:wrap on button rows, min-inline-size:0 on items holding long strings, auto-fit/minmax grids, never mask overflow with overflow:hidden.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Button groups wrap; result grids use repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%,Npx),1fr)); outputs use overflow-wrap:anywhere; measured 0px horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3 and 1280x800.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow on mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Adapt components to container size with intrinsic sizing rather than fixed widths.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Stages are single grid columns with min-width:0; code blocks scroll internally (overflow-x:auto) instead of widening the page.

summary: The failure half of the feature made observable: the detached-document InvalidStateError and WebIDL's TypeError-as-rejection rule, each shown verbatim against the old silent/synchronous behaviour.
